comparison: exact whole line excluding original CR/LF terminator; no normalization
scope: Only contiguous duplicate suffix lines of the final canonical TRAIN unit of each sourceDocument. Do not stitch around internal removed lines.
retain: Retain every original occurrence in source with lexicographically smallest SHA256(sourceDocument UTF8). Other sources trimmed only at suffix. Non-suffix occurrences remain untouched.
emptyUnit: Drop empty or whitespace-only unit in all views; never train BOS/EOS-only
tokenizer: existing own vocabulary and merges unchanged
randomCuts: For changed units only, same seed SHA256(2049|sourceDocument|startLine), same8..24 Unicode-character fragmentation. Unchanged units copied exactly.
